logline: A municipal water engineer maps a coastal delta city learning to move in silence, then has to choose whether the people she saves will depend on one voice—or on each other.
intendedAudience: Adult & Young Adult Fiction (Original Serialized Survival Drama)

visualBible.medium: Original hand-inked 2D editorial illustration with layered paper grain and restrained parallax
visualBible.silhouetteRules: Characters have distinct human proportions and functional clothing. Rhea’s recognizable silhouette is a cropped slate-teal rain jacket with signal-coral cuff tabs, rolled map case, and brass pressure gauge (no yellow hat or borrowed mascot).
visualBible.lightingRules: Natural ambient light, salt mist, tide marks on damp masonry, amber streetlights reflecting in canal water.
bannedStyles: No yellow beanie mascot or competitor character copying
No imitation of living manga/manhwa artists or proprietary studio styles
No gratuitous gore-first thumbnail shock loops

rules.title: Infection Vector: Contact Only
rules.fictionalRule: Transmission occurs strictly through a bite or infected saliva entering broken skin. It is NOT airborne, and it is NOT caused by drinking municipal water.
rules.narrativeImplications: Characters gradually discover this through careful observation and medical caution over multiple seasons, debunking wild rumors.
rules.prohibitedMisconceptions: Do not portray city water as poisonous or infectious. Do not include airborne spore masks as an infection defense.

rules.title: The Still: Residual Motor Habits
rules.fictionalRule: The infected ("The Still") retain fragments of motor habit (turning toward familiar vibrations, reaching for door plates, repeating routine footsteps). They possess NO speech, telepathy, or deliberate strategy.
rules.narrativeImplications: Their behavior is physically plausible and consistent. Danger comes from proximity and consequence, not sudden arbitrary teleportation.
rules.prohibitedMisconceptions: Do not portray the infected talking, planning coordinated traps, or having magical instincts.

rules.title: The Mechanical Rhythm & Brittle Sirens
rules.fictionalRule: The infected respond to repeating low-frequency mechanical rhythms produced by the city’s brittle flood pump network (an 8-beat pulse). The pulse does NOT create or control the infection—it merely redirects movement unreliably.
rules.narrativeImplications: Using the signal is an ethical dilemma: diverting the Still from one district often pushes them toward another shelter.
rules.prohibitedMisconceptions: The pulse is not a superpower or permanent zombie hack.

rules.title: No Miracle Cure: Resilient Community
rules.fictionalRule: The ending is about building durable, transparent community governance and truthful maps—not a magical one-shot antidote that erases every loss.
rules.narrativeImplications: Scientific inquiry by Dr. Amala Nwosu focuses on epidemiology, quarantine ethics, and care rather than cinematic weaponized cures.
rules.prohibitedMisconceptions: Never introduce secret miracle serums or instant vaccines.

characters.name: Rhea Mistry
characters.visualAnchor: Cropped slate-teal rain jacket with signal-coral cuff tabs, rolled canvas map case, brass pressure gauge
characters.psychologicalWound: Signed an engineering memo approving an old service route closure that now obstructs survivor evacuation; struggles with sharing uncertainty.
characters.knowledgeScope: Basin hydraulics, decommissioned sluices, low-pressure mains, analog telemetry dials
characters.voiceStyle: Methodical, quiet, precise, observant; speaks with practical clarity rather than rhetoric
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 31-year-old South Asian woman with keen analytical eyes, hair tied back securely, practical utilitarian rain gear, weathered brass pressure gauge at belt

characters.name: Kabir Mistry
characters.role: Field Sound Archivist & Community Radio Volunteer
characters.visualAnchor: Heavy canvas rucksack with directional microphone boom, open reel audio tape loops, notebook
characters.psychologicalWound: Left the family home years prior after an unresolved disagreement; refuses to let forgotten places be erased.
characters.knowledgeScope: Acoustic geography, radio relays, oral neighborhood histories, community routes
characters.voiceStyle: Warm, observant, empathetic, slightly hesitant; values recording truth over command
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 26-year-old South Asian young man with windblown hair, vintage field recorder, notebook tucked in pocket

characters.name: Mara Ilyan
characters.visualAnchor: Grease-stained heavy canvas work coat, brass pocket compass, toolbox
characters.psychologicalWound: Her harbor crew was left stranded during an earlier institutional storm response; deeply skeptical of centralized orders.
characters.knowledgeScope: Diesel marine engines, tidal currents, harbor islands, battery banks
characters.voiceStyle: Grounded, caustic, direct, protective of working people
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 47-year-old woman with silver-streaked dark hair, calloused hands, durable maritime coat

characters.name: Dr. Amala Nwosu
characters.visualAnchor: Dark wool field vest, clip-on reading spectacles, clinical logbook
characters.psychologicalWound: Witnessed public panic caused by false early assurances; insists on communicating uncertainty honestly.
characters.knowledgeScope: Disease vectors, public health logistics, quarantine ethics, consent protocols
characters.voiceStyle: Calm, measured, scientifically rigorous, deeply humane
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 38-year-old Black woman with quiet authority, thoughtful expression, field clipboard

characters.name: Yusef "Yuse" Rahal
characters.visualAnchor: Scuffed high-traction runners, lightweight orange windbreaker, messenger bag
characters.psychologicalWound: Resents adults treating him as either helpless or as a disposable runner; fiercely independent.
characters.knowledgeScope: Rooftop bridges, fire escapes, line-of-sight signal paths, courier codes
characters.voiceStyle: Fast, sharp, alert, dry humor under pressure
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 17-year-old agile young man, observant dark eyes, bright runner sneakers, lightweight messenger strap

characters.name: Tomas Vale
characters.visualAnchor: Faded municipal emergency blazer, lanyard with security fobs, master key ring
characters.psychologicalWound: Believes panic kills more than disasters; withheld information in the past with catastrophic results.
characters.knowledgeScope: Official emergency directives, siren network topology, civil defense stores
characters.voiceStyle: Authoritative, burdened, procedural; struggles when centralized commands fail
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 53-year-old man with tired graying temples, stern jaw, wrinkled official uniform

characters.name: Sima Dey
characters.visualAnchor: Hand-knitted cardigan, heavy reading glasses on cord, canvas satchel of annotated paper flood maps
characters.psychologicalWound: Knows how easily paper maps were manipulated to erase working-class neighborhood rights.
characters.knowledgeScope: Pre-digital flood barrier maps, deed books, old drainage bylaws, forgotten city routes
characters.voiceStyle: Dry, witty, unrelenting in seeking documented evidence
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 68-year-old woman with shrewd knowing gaze, silver hair in a neat bun, holding hand-corrected paper blueprints

characters.name: Linh Cho
characters.visualAnchor: High-visibility dispatcher vest, handheld radio transceiver, transit schedule board
characters.psychologicalWound: Haunted by stranded trains she could not reverse when the power grid tripped.
characters.knowledgeScope: Transit viaducts, track power substations, line blockages, elevated vantage points
characters.voiceStyle: Disciplined, steady, protective of protocol until people require improvisation
characters.appearancePromptGuidance: 42-year-old East Asian woman with disciplined posture, reflective transit vest, walkie-talkie at shoulder

locations.name: South Gate Water Control Works
locations.environmentalDescription: Concrete sluice structure built in 1974 with manual handwheels, low-pressure iron pipes, and an analog control mezzanine.
locations.infrastructureNotes: Controls flood barriers between Basin 3 and the harbor; contains the primary 8-beat pressure gauge.
locations.visualPalette: Industrial concrete, peeling teal enamel, dark river water, brass dials

locations.name: The Canal Commons
locations.environmentalDescription: Network of brick townhouses, pedestrian footbridges, moored barges, and shared rainwater cisterns.
locations.infrastructureNotes: Self-organized residential zone where survivors share water and messages.
locations.visualPalette: Weathered red brick, sodium lanterns, dark reflecting canals

locations.name: Ternfall Harbor Islands
locations.environmentalDescription: Chain of three low-lying islands with salt marshes, decommissioned ferry slips, and a solar battery station.
locations.infrastructureNotes: Reachable only by shallow-draft boats; houses Kabir’s sound archives.
locations.visualPalette: Salt marsh green, fog gray, rusted iron moorings, lighthouse beacon light

factions.name: South Gate Survivors
factions.ideology: Pragmatic, mutualist survival based on technical transparency and consent
factions.materialInterests: Securing clean water access and maintaining warning nodes

factions.name: The Canal Commons Council
factions.ideology: Decentralized mutual aid; refusal of centralized emergency autocracy
factions.materialInterests: Fair distribution of food, medical supplies, and route safety
factions.relationshipToSouthGate: Allied neighbors dependent on floodgate stability

factions.name: Continuity Directorate
factions.ideology: Hierarchical central command; believes secrecy prevents panic
factions.materialInterests: Retaining control of siren network and emergency stockpiles
factions.relationshipToSouthGate: Claims official legal jurisdiction over Rhea’s facility

originalityDeclarations: Original fiction set in fictional city of Ternfall; not a real city or real public health event.
No character, dialogue, panel, or plot beat copied from Beanie Survives or any published manhwa.
No medical or survival advice claims; all factual engineering details sourced and reviewed.
